name: jarvis-command-center
description: HezTech (هستک) — Executive Desktop Workspace & Multi-Agent Intelligence Center

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),os=require('os'),path=require('path'),{spawnSync}=require('child_process');const dataDir=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'heztech-npm-test-'));const env={...process.env,HEZTECH_DATA_DIR:dataDir,HEZTECH_TEST_ISOLATED:'1'};for(const key of ['GEMINI_API_KEY','HEZTECH_GEMINI_API_KEY','GOOGLE_API_KEY','GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS','OPENROUTER_API_KEY','HEZTECH_OPENROUTER_API_KEY','OPENAI_API_KEY','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','COHERE_API_KEY','MISTRAL_API_KEY','DEEPSEEK_API_KEY','GROQ_API_KEY','TOGETHER_API_KEY','FIREWORKS_API_KEY'])delete env[key];for(const file of ['test/test-agent-tools.js','test/test-live-session.js','test/test-chat-lifecycle.js']){const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[file],{env,stdio:'inherit'});if(result.error){console.error(result.error);process.exitCode=1;break}if(result.status!==0){process.exitCode=result.status||1;break}}fs.rmSync(dataDir,{recursive:true,force:true});"
